name: strata-copilot-chat
description: Strata for Copilot Chat: run Strata local OpenAI-compatible models in GitHub Copilot Chat like LM Studio. Text, tool calls, images, reasoning effort, auto-detected limits and automatic reconnect when Strata restarts. Built using the LM Studio provider extension.

strata.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Strata OpenAI-compatible API (the 'API base URL' shown in the Strata app).

strata.apiKey.description: Optional API key. Leave empty when Strata has no key configured.

strata.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens Strata may generate per reply. 0 detects the limit from Strata; a positive value overrides it.

strata.contextWindow.description: Context window (in tokens) reported to Copilot Chat for Strata models. 0 detects the window from Strata; a positive value overrides it.

strata.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent to Strata. 'default' leaves it to Strata.

strata.reasoningBudgetTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may spend on reasoning. 0 leaves it to Strata.

strata.fitMaxTokens.description: Let Strata shrink max_tokens to fit the remaining context instead of rejecting long requests.

strata.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Leave empty to use Strata's default.

strata.topP.description: Nucleus sampling (top_p). Leave empty to use Strata's default.
